description: Minimum accessible parking spaces for a new or redeveloped Ontario lot under Ontario Regulation 191/11 section 80.36, the Type A and Type B split, access aisles and painted stall line length. Every parameter is optional and has a default. Preliminary planning only. Municipal zoning by-laws and the Building Code can add requirements, and the designer of record governs.

rows.description: Rows of stalls, used for the stall line length.

spaces.description: Total number of parking spaces in the lot.

stall_length.description: Stall length. Use the dimension from your municipal zoning by-law. Unit: m or ft.
